testing_attributes.rule: All key interactive elements, form fields, buttons, tables, navigation links, and state cards must include data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure React JS components (.js files) use clean tailwind styles remapped in tailwind.config.js. Maintain the calm, warm editorial feel with serif headings ('font-serif') and clean sans body text ('font-sans'). Never use harsh high-contrast black/white gradients or Inter/Roboto fonts.
